messages:
maya: Heads-up: after publishing sdk v3.2.0 a couple of our Vite + edge example apps started failing during build with `Error: Cannot find module`. Repro attached.

sam: Could be the exports map tweak we merged yesterday. Bundlers can be picky about conditional fields.

nora: Yep. Our `exports` currently only has conditional import/require paths, no unconditioned fallback or `types` entry. Vite/esbuild + some edge adapters end up resolving to a cjs path that doesn't exist at runtime.

maya: Repro steps: `pnpm -w --filter examples/vite-swr install && pnpm --filter examples/vite-swr build` then `vercel dev --listen`. Build log: ```Error: Cannot find module '/workspace/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.cjs' at Module._resolveFilename```

tyler: Can you paste the package.json snippet?

maya: ```"exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }```

nora: Two issues: 1) older bundlers and some edge runtimes prefer a non-conditional entry (or look at `main`/`module`), 2) we didn't include `types` in the exports so TS in examples breaks.

sam: Also saw a couple sample apps using default import (`import sdk from '@redwood-inference/sdk'`). With ESM-only main outputs the interop changed and `sdk` can be an empty object which then causes auth helpers to be undefined and runtime auth errors.

tyler: Quick mitigation: publish a compat patch with `main`/`module` + `types` and a fallback entry so bundlers have a path. Longer-term: standardize our builds and add CI that builds all examples with Vite/esbuild + vercel dev to catch regressions.

maya: Proposed interim `package.json` fields: ```"main": "dist/index.cjs", "module": "dist/index.mjs", "types": "dist/index.d.ts", "exports": { ".": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }```

tyler: I'd avoid adding a non-standard `default` key in exports. Use `main/module/types` + exports map. Also add a tiny test that does `vite build` + `node ./dist/server.js` against the example.

nora: Agree. I'll add a TS smoke test for the examples too so missing types in exports fail CI.

sam: Short-term publish plan: cut v3.2.1 with compat fields and tag it `compat` to avoid surprising customers on latest tag while we iterate.

ci-bot: publish-bot: published @redwood-inference/sdk@3.2.1-compat to npm (temporary compat build) :rocket:

maya: Thanks bot — I updated the example package.json to pin to the compat tag and opened a PR with changelog notes.

nora: Opening an RFC to lock down build targets + release checklist: ensure dual cjs/esm outputs, exports map includes types, and examples smoke tests.

tyler: Issue created: "sdk: exports compatibility + examples CI smoke tests" referencing this thread.

maya: Closing loop: once RFC lands we'll remove the compat tag and publish a clean v3.3.0. Thanks all :tada:
